rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: INTerway
Exhibition name: Milky Way
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gerrit Pieter Ilsink (Netherlands, before 1989).
Introduced in Netherlands by Interplant BV in 1991 as 'Milky Way'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Mild fragrance. 20 petals. Average diameter 4". Medium to large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents: New Zealand - Patent No: 874 on 29 Jun 1994
rows.Parentage:
Esmeralda (hybrid tea, Kordes, 1973) ×
True Love (hybrid tea, Delbard, 1970)
